source: NIST ACVP-Server gen-val sample vectors for LMS (SP 800-208 / RFC 8554), converted from internalProjection.json
note: Every LMS test group published in ACVP-Server at this commit uses the SP 800-208 SHA-256/192 parameter sets (LMS_SHA256_M24_H5/H10 with LMOTS_SHA256_N24_W1/W2, typecodes 0x0A/0x0B and 0x05/0x06). There are no SHA256/M32 (RFC 8554 Table 1/2) cases. The M32-only verifiers in this repository must reject every key here (48-byte public key, foreign typecodes); the tests additionally check the vectors with a test-only n = m = 24 instantiation of the same algorithms. Seeds are n = 24 bytes and keys follow RFC 8554 Appendix A.
